clips.name: x0122a
clips.text: As for Leo Bahng, he dodged an assassin by going to the toilet.
clips.heard: As for Leo Bang, he dodged an assassin by going to the toilet.

clips.name: x0122b
clips.text: As for Leo Bahng, he dodged an assassin with a toilet break.
clips.heard: As for Leo Bong, he dodged an assassin with a toilet break.

clips.name: x02a
clips.text: This was the Hongmen Feast. Swords everywhere, and only one man died. He wasn't there.
clips.heard: This was the Hongmen Feast, swords everywhere, and only one man died. He wasn't there.

clips.name: x03a
clips.text: The empire fell. Leo Bahng grabbed the capital.
clips.heard: The Empire fell. Liu Bang grabbed the capital.

clips.name: x04a
clips.text: But Shyahng Yoo was stronger: four times Leo Bahng's army.
clips.heard: But Xiang Yu was stronger, four times Liu Bang's army.

clips.name: x05a
clips.text: His own officer snitched to Shyahng Yoo: "Leo Bahng wants to be king."
clips.heard: His own officer snitched to Xiang Yu. Liu Bang wants to be king.

clips.name: x06a
clips.text: Shyahng Yoo raged: "We attack at dawn!"
clips.heard: Xiong Yu raged! We attack at dawn!

clips.name: x07a
clips.text: That night, Shyahng Yoo's uncle warned Leo Bahng, who at once made him an in-law.
clips.heard: That night, Xiaoyang Yu's uncle warned Liu Bang, who at once made him an in-law.

clips.name: x08a
clips.text: Next morning, Leo Bahng apologized: "Surely some rat lied to you."
clips.heard: Next morning, Leo Bang apologized. Surely some rat lied to you.

clips.name: x09a
clips.text: Shyahng Yoo blurted out: "Your man Tsao Wooshahng told me."
clips.heard: Shying you, blurted out, your man Sa Wuxiang told me.

clips.name: x10a
clips.text: Shyahng Yoo kept him for drinks. But his adviser, Fahn Dzung, was sure Leo Bahng must die.
clips.heard: Xiang Yu kept him for drinks, but his advisor, Fan Zhong, was sure Liu Bang must die.

clips.name: x11a
clips.text: Three times, Fahn Dzung raised his jade, meaning: kill him. No reaction.
clips.heard: Three times, Fanzung raised his jade, meaning kill him. No reaction.

clips.name: x12a
clips.text: Fahn Dzung sent in a sword dancer to stab Leo Bahng mid-dance.
clips.heard: Fanzung sent in a sword dancer to stab Liu Bang mid-dance.

clips.name: x13a
clips.text: Shyahng Yoo's uncle joined the dance, shielding his new in-law.
clips.heard: Shang Yu's uncle joined the dance, shielding his new in-law.

clips.name: x14a
clips.text: Leo Bahng's man, Fahn Kwhy, flattened the guards and burst in.
clips.heard: Leo Bung's man, Phan Khoi, flattened the guards and burst in.

clips.name: x15a
clips.text: Shyahng Yoo called him brave and gave him a leg of pork. Raw.
clips.heard: Xiang Yu called him brave, and gave him a leg of pork, raw.

clips.name: x16a
clips.text: Leo Bahng went to the toilet and waved Fahn Kwhy out too.
clips.heard: Leo Bang went to the toilet and waved Fonkwai out too.

clips.name: x17a
clips.text: Leo Bahng hadn't said goodbye. Fahn Kwhy said: "They're the knife, we're the fish. Forget goodbye!"
clips.heard: Leo Bong hadn't said goodbye. Fonkwai said, They're the knife, we're the fish. Forget goodbye.

clips.name: x18a
clips.text: Leo Bahng ditched his convoy, jumped on one horse, and took a back road home.
clips.heard: Leo Bong ditched his convoy, jumped on one horse, and took a back road home.

clips.name: x19a
clips.text: Only once Leo Bahng reached camp, his adviser walked in: "He drank too much."
clips.heard: Only once Leo Bang reached camp, his advisor walked in. He drank too much.

clips.name: x20a
clips.text: The first thing Leo Bahng did: kill Tsao Wooshahng, the officer who snitched.
clips.heard: The first thing Liu Bang did, killed Cao Wuxiang, the officer who snitched.

clips.name: x21a
clips.text: And that name? Shyahng Yoo let it slip himself.
clips.heard: And that name, shall you let it slip himself?
